d: Voluminous, fluffy platinum white hair flares out from beneath a helmet. Sharp, glowing emerald green eyes peer out from a youthful, mature face. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a dark olive and brown leather armor set consisting of a breastplate, gauntlets, and armored leggings with brown plated knee guards. A green metallic horned helmet is worn, and a large, double-sided grey metal battle axe is held in one hand.
